description: Previous word-by-word subtitle with translucent black background; exact source preserved alongside this file.
css: .word-subtitle{--caption-unit:calc(100cqw / 4608);position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(194 * var(--caption-unit));transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:max-content;max-width:90%;height:calc(118 * var(--caption-unit));padding:0 calc(57.5 * var(--caption-unit));background:rgba(0,0,0,.48);color:#e6e6e6;text-align:center;font-family:"Artwork Myriad Pro","Myriad Pro","PingFang SC",sans-serif;font-size:calc(75 * var(--caption-unit));font-style:normal;font-weight:400;line-height:1;letter-spacing:normal;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:none;border-radius:0}
